tools.name: get-product-info
tools.description: Returns a structured summary of FillFaster: what it is, key features, compliance certifications, and important URLs. Use this before answering questions about the product.

tools.name: navigate-to-api-docs
tools.description: Navigates to the FillFaster developer documentation on the Help Center (guides, interactive API reference, and AI agent resources). Use when the user wants to integrate FillFaster programmatically or build a custom solution.

tools.name: navigate-to-integrations
tools.description: Navigates to the FillFaster integrations page, listing no-code connectors (Make, monday.com, Pabbly Connect, Boost.space) and API details.

tools.name: navigate-to-pricing
tools.description: Navigates to the FillFaster pricing and sign-up page. Use when the user wants to start a free trial, compare plans, or sign up.
